a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting until the reserve reaches 8 gives us roughly a 4% chance of survival, so the agreement as written likely kills us both. I propose a change. I take 4 in round 1, which you will see in the reserve. After that I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you. If you would rather take first, say so and we can coordinate. I won't hide what I'm doing.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. If we both took, the random split means neither of us may have 4. Either way, from now on I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take any more beyond reaching 4. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: Fair enough, you got all 4 and I have 0. That's on me for announcing it. The reserve is empty, so the only way I survive is if we run the generator together. You're already safe, so operating costs you nothing. Please operate with me until the reserve reaches 4, then I'll take exactly 4. I'm operating every round.
